items.title: How Does .NET Aspire Connect the Dots Between Services?
items.summary:
In a distributed application, understanding how services, databases, APIs, and other dependencies fit together can be difficult. When that architecture is unclear, debugging failures and tracing requests becomes even harder.

In this Short, Fiodar Sazanavets explains how .NET Aspire gives teams a clearer view of their application—helping them understand service relationships, monitor dependencies, and troubleshoot the system as a whole.

Learn more in How to Ship Distributed Systems with Confidence:
https://hubs.la/Q04t8BbY0

#DotNetAspire #DistributedSystems #Observability #CloudNative #Microservices #SoftwareArchitecture #DotNet #Shorts
